quest.title: The South Wind Brings Adventure
quest.description: While investigating imaginary friends with Venti, Ellin asked you to search for the adventurer Jack within the Temple of the Lion. It seems he is traveling together with the legendary adventurer, Stanley.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x500, Mora x31125, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x7

chapter.title: Should You Be Trapped in a Windless Land

talks.objective: Head to the Temple of the Lion

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Temple of the Lion... We explored this place once before, didn't we? During the Stormterror incident.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, are those guys...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: *panting*

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I was so sure I was about to die!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: To be fair, that could have gone either way.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: So — you must be Jack the Adventurer, I assume?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Yes... Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Actually, we came looking for you.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Ellin has a message for you. She said she won't be able to join you today to plan out your next adventure together. She'll join you some other time.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Oh, I see... I feel bad you had to come all this way to find me... and then had to rescue me...

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Huh? I don't see what all the fuss is about. It was nothing that I, Stanley, couldn't have dealt with by myself!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, you're Stanley? You're that legendary adventurer? Renowned in all of Mondstadt? Who once set foot in the Mare Jivari!?

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: Hehehe, the very same!

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Hahaha! I must say, it's an honor to meet one as legendary as yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Well then, how would everyone like to proceed? Head back, or head further inside?

response.speaker: Stanley
response.text: Hehehe, well... I think you're now in the safe hands of Stanley, the great explorer and legend of Mondstadt!

response.speaker: Stanley
response.text: In which case, why head back now?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Okay, motion passed by unanimous consent! Let's head further in.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I think we should keep going. With Stanley by our side, we'll have no problem.

dialogues.speaker: Stanley
dialogues.text: So. I'm guessing you mostly came here because you wanted to hear my adventure stories, am I right?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Traveler, I believe I have made a small discovery.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Could I ask you to use the nirnama detector once more?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What? Stanley has an imaginary friend?

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: It seems his imaginary friend is a seasoned warrior... covered in scars from head to foot, and a look of staunch determination on his face.

choices.text: It fits Stanley's description of himself.

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: You're saying his imaginary friend is an idealized version of his own self?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Interesting idea! But is it true?

response.speaker: Stanley
response.text: Please excuse me, I'll be leaving now.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Bye, Stanley!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Do you two still have time to spare?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: What is it?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: A few days ago, Stanley got drunk and told me a secret — something he's never told anyone before.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: The weapons he took on his adventure all those years ago... they were none other than those once wielded by Mondstadt's greatest hero, Vennessa herself! The <color=#00E1FFFF>Sword of Brilliant Valor</color> and the <color=#00E1FFFF>Shield of Magnificent Honor</color>!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I don't know whether you believe me, but... apparently, both the sword and shield are still right here in Mondstadt, over in <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Since you guys are the experts at this... Can you come with me to try and retrieve these two legendary weapons?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: You bet! This is Stanley we're talking about!

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: If I can just get ahold of something impressive enough to show my family what I'm capable of, maybe they'll finally come around to the idea of me being an adventurer...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Right now, I'm just a rookie. My abilities are limited, and my parents don't support my goals one bit...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: So, what do you say? Help a guy out?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I can't bring myself to tell Stanley about it, because my reasons are so... selfish. But, I swear I'll give the weapons back to him as soon as I'm done!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, poor Jack... Let's help him out!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Venti, you coming too?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Mm... I don't know...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Oh, one other thing — I have a bottle of rare vintage wine that I had someone fetch for me a couple years ago. Help me find these weapons and it's all yours!

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh, <color=#00E1FFFF>Dadaupa Gorge</color>, was it? Hehe, let's hurry, there's no time to lose!

choices.text: Hard to say no after that sob story.
Why did he abandon them in the wild, then?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I dunno, outstanding individuals always come with their quirks, right?

choices.text: I knew there was something weird about his story...

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: Oh? You thought so too, huh?

response.speaker: Venti
response.text: I agree. He wasn't telling the whole story.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Thanks for agreeing to help me out.

dialogues.speaker: Ellin
dialogues.text: Jack's at the <color=#00E1FFFF>Temple of the Lion</color>. Don't forget...
